Short description is Spell Vamp. {{ItemIcon|Bloodlust Axe|size=20px}} [[Bloodlust Axe]] was merge with {{ItemIcon|War Axe|size=20px}} [[War Axe]] on [[Patch 1.8.92|Patch Notes 1.8.92]] ==Ability== {{SpellCard |name=Unique Attribute |image=Item Bloodlust Axe ML.png |ability=Passive |affects=Self |description=+20% Spell Vamp }} ==Story== Battle is the way of survival. ==Version History== ===[[Patch 1.8.92]]===
Removed
{{ItemIcon|Bloodlust Axe|size=20px}} [[Bloodlust Axe]] has been combined with {{ItemIcon|War Axe|size=20px}} [[War Axe]]. ===[[Patch 1.1.76]]=== We feel that for heroes who mainly rely on skills to deal physical attacks, the Tooth of Greed's Physical Lifesteal is not the best choice for them. This gear will be more suitable as it has a high cooldown reduction and blood thirsty effects.
Added
[[File:{{{1|}}}Item Bloodlust Axe ML.png|text-bottom|{{{size|20px}}}|link=Bloodlust_Axe{{{1|}}}]]Bloodlust Axe :* Price: 1970 :* Attributes: +70 Physical Attack :* Unique Attribute: +20% Cooldown Reduction :* '''Unique Passive - Bloodlust''': Restores 15% of damage dealt as HP for the hero when hero's skills hits a target. ==References== {{Reflist}} Bloodlust Axe information, Retrieved May 10, 2024 from https://mobile-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Bloodlust_Axe {{Equipment}}

Conceal.title: Conceal
Conceal.content:
{{Infobox item |itemname=Conceal |itemcost=0 |recipecost= |category=Roaming |tier= |type= |status=Available }} : '''Conceal''' is a Roaming Equipment Blessing. ==Ability== {{SpellCard |name=Conceal |image=Item Conceal ML.png |ability=Active |affects= Enemy |affects2= Ally |description=

Conceals nearby allied heroes (including self) and grants them 24%-60% extra Movement Speed (scale with Gold from Thriving) for 5 seconds or until they deal or take damage.

Heroes with this Blessing no longer share minion and creep rewards with allied heroes and need to accumulate 600 Gold from Thriving (up to 1500 Gold) to unlock this skill. }} ==Version History== ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Equipment}}
